facts.text: A character reference sheet composed of multiple panels on a dark background, arranged in three rows: a large cinematic 'HERO' panel on top, three full-body turnaround panels (FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK) in the middle row, and four detail panels (FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, BOOTS) along the bottom.

The person wears an all-black outfit: a dark zip-up jacket with a high collar, shoulder straps, buckles and a small patch on the chest, a dark undershirt, dark cargo-style trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.

In the hero panel the person stands facing forward but with the head turned to the left in a three-quarter view, arms hanging at the sides, on a wet rooftop or elevated walkway with metal railings on both sides.
The hero panel is a rainy night scene: visible rain streaks, wet reflective ground, blurred city lights and a warm-lit building facade in the background, with cool blue-grey ambient light.

The three turnaround panels show the same figure standing upright with arms at the sides: front view facing camera, side profile facing left, and back view showing the jacket's rear and the tied topknot.

The bottom detail panels show a close-up of the face with a serious neutral expression, a close-up of the jacket collar with straps and metal buckles, a close-up of two weathered hands with visible veins and dirt, and a close-up of a worn black lace-up boot.
Legible panel labels in white capital letters read: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, BOOTS.
The turnaround and detail panels use a flat, dark studio-like background and moody low-key lighting, while the hero panel is a fully realized cinematic environment.

facts.text: The image is a composite creature reference sheet: one large hero panel at the top and six smaller labeled panels below, arranged in two rows.

The main panel shows a massive dark charcoal-black dragon with armor-like scales, a long horned skull, dorsal spines, large membrane wings, four clawed legs, and a long tail; it stands on wet rocky terrain with its wings spread and head lowered.
The setting is a dark, misty volcanic landscape with jagged rock formations, shallow reflective water or wet ground, and glowing orange lava or embers in the background.
A lower-left detail panel labeled HEAD CLOSE shows the dragon’s horned head in profile, with layered dark scales and a visible amber-orange eye.
A lower-row panel labeled WING MEMBRANE shows the wing’s dark, leathery membrane stretched between long skeletal wing fingers.
A lower-row panel labeled CLAW AND FOOT shows a heavily scaled foot with large curved claws.
A lower-right panel labeled SCALE DETAIL shows overlapping, ridged dark scales with subtle blue-green iridescence.
The middle-row panels are labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and REAR and show the same dragon from those three viewpoints.

limitations: The inset panels are relatively small, limiting fine anatomical detail beyond what is broadly visible.

value.action: The massive black dragon launches forward over a sprawling volcanic battleground, membrane wings spread wide and horns cutting through drifting smoke as the woman in the black technical jacket sits low on its back, one hand braced against its armored scales. Embers and ash streak past them while distant battle lines glow below.
value.what_changes: The pair shifts from a poised launch into forward flight over the battleground.

value.action: The woman's face fills the frame, scar visible over one eyebrow, jaw set and eyes fixed ahead as wind whips her topknot and collar. She tightens her grip on the dragon's neck while its huge wing sweeps past behind her, casting a moving shadow across her face and jacket.
value.what_changes: Her focused determination sharpens as the battlefield rushes closer behind her.

value.action: The dragon folds its wings and dives toward the battle line, claws extended and jaws opening in a roar, while the woman leans hard into the plunge. Lava glow and embers burst upward around them as armored scales catch the orange light and the ground rushes up.
value.what_changes: They drop from circling flight into a full-speed dive straight into the battle.
